description: We're building Moto View, a Tanzania burning-activity calendar for the MODIS & VIIRS Hot Spots challenge. We harmonize two satellite fire records so over a decade of burning can be explored on one consistent calendar. We have the data and coding side covered and want a third teammate for stats/remote sensing, UI design, or pitch storytelling. Beginners welcome. Come ship a working demo with us. We are in Kenya. We chose Tanzania because it is close by and has higher fire rates than Kenya.
